products.short_description: Turn assessment findings into fixes — a prioritized, gated remediation playbook that closes the gaps a Defender Security Optimization Assessment surfaces.
products.description:
Turn assessment findings into fixes — a prioritized, gated remediation playbook that closes the gaps a Defender Security Optimization Assessment surfaces.

An assessment that just produces a report gathers dust. This remediation playbook takes the prioritized findings from any Defender Security Optimization Assessment and provides the step-by-step, pilot-first remediation for each finding category — with -WhatIf/simulate-gated change scripts, verification, and a re-score to prove the gaps closed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Finding-to-remediation mapping across all five Defender products
  • Prioritized, pilot-first remediation steps per finding category
  • Change scripts gated to -WhatIf / simulate before enforce
  • Verification and re-score to prove each gap is closed
  • Change-tracking and a remediation evidence report

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The assessment backlog actually closed — each finding remediated pilot-first, verified, and re-scored, with evidence.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SOAREM-Discovery.ps1 — read-only ingest of a Defender Security Optimization Assessment findings
    • SOAREM-Remediate.ps1 — the GATED change helper. Defaults to a safe -WhatIf preview (touches
    • SOAREM-Report.ps1 — produce the change-tracked remediation evidence report (what changed, when, by
    • SOAREM-Rescore.ps1 — read-only re-score after remediation; compares the new posture score to the
    • SOAREM-Validate.ps1 — read-only post-change verification that a remediated control is now correct

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
